authorization.scope: one new full-Train REAL POS_CONTRAST theta fit plus official Test feature inference; no Kaggle upload

input.record_id: identity and row alignment only; never a model feature

required_components: original C2_B structured state, scaler, OHE, and C2_B LogisticRegression
original full-Train A02 TF-IDF vectorizer and tokenizer state
original full-Train A02 observed Test probabilities
C1_B structured state and full-Train HGB missing-stream fallback

features.source: the frozen POS_CONTRAST_V1 third-position TF-IDF block built with the original C2_B vectorizer
features.tokenizer: the exact saved full-Train A02 C2_B TfidfVectorizer preprocessor and tokenizer
features.position_bins: the original three contiguous token thirds
features.position_features: (1+log(count))*shared_IDF, concatenate three blocks, one whole-row L2 normalization before projection
features.contrast_output: append projected Z to unchanged base; no post-projection normalization
features.fit_arm: REAL only; no shuffled or bag estimator fit

model.fixed_offset: original C2_B bag intercept + original C2_B base matrix @ original C2_B bag coefficients; do not include the original POS_BAG_OFFSET gamma
model.new_parameters: one REAL contrast theta vector initialized at zero; no new intercept
model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize, L-BFGS-B, jac=True, float64, maxiter=2000, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-6, maxls=50
model.acceptance: optimizer success; finite coefficients, loss and gradient; final objective <= zero-theta objective + 1e-8

inference_policy.missing_stream: exact saved full-Train C1_B HGB probability
inference_policy.gamma_zero_replay: replay the same fixed policy with theta=0; no new fit
inference_policy.relation_to_historical_pilot: the E79 full-Train fallback is the already fitted full-Train C1_B HGB; historical E67/E75 fallback artifacts and pilot verdict are unchanged

budget.cap_amendment: none; reserve one available slot under the current live cap
budget.old_conditional_reservation: POS_CONTRAST_V1:CONDITIONAL_E79_AFTER_SOL_REVIEW was released and must not be reused

boundaries.fit_labels: read only after the unique durable FIT_STARTED event and committed pre-fit freeze/reservation; full official Train only
boundaries.test: feature inference only after trained-state freeze is committed
boundaries.sample_submission: read schema and ordered IDs only to verify exact output format
boundaries.kaggle: not contacted; no upload authorized in this lane

output.status: exploratory candidate for Sol review; not submitted
